descriptionChirho: Possessive adjective indicating personal ownership or belonging, used attributively or predicatively with various nouns (one's own land, body, master, etc.).
Used adverbially in the idiom κατ᾽ ἰδίαν (kat' idian) meaning 'privately, in private, by oneself, apart from others'.
Substantivized usage (οἱ ἴδιοι) referring to one's own people, family, friends, or associates, as in John 1:11 'his own received him not'.
Distributive sense meaning 'individually, each in particular, respectively', used when assigning something to each person separately.
